video_title: Draymond's Opt-Out Wasn't a Coincidence — Nick Friedell

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr's desire to get younger and improve back-to-back performance
quotes.excerpt: Steve Kerr understandably said, we have to get younger. We have to have a team full of guys
quotes.quote: A month and a half ago, Steve Kerr understandably said, we have to get younger. We have to have a team full of guys that can play back-to-backs because we know Steph and Draymond and at that point, there was some uncertainty whether or not Horford and Porzingis would be back. They are not at that stage of their career where they can. And now they have brought back the exact same team with Melton and you have Yaxel and Looney and J. Jones and now you are just kind of like, okay.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's opt-out as an indicator of LeBron James's potential move
quotes.excerpt: There is no way that Draymond didn't know something. There is no way he didn't go to

text_blocks.speaker: Mark
text_blocks.text: Nick, obviously the first domino that fell in maybe LeBron to the Warriors becoming a likely scenario was Draymond opting out of his nearly $28 million player option. In your mind, was that made with some sort of information on Draymond's end about LeBron's intentions or was that just simply the Warriors keeping their options open?

text_blocks.speaker: Nick Friedell
text_blocks.text: Mr. Grani, there is no way that Draymond didn't know something. There is no way he didn't go to Mike Dunleavy and to Steve Kerr and to the Lakers and say, hey, we at least have a chance here. And I am willing to basically defer whatever is going to happen for a little while to figure out what may come of that. But there is no way when you have that strong of a relationship like Draymond does with LeBron and you know your contract situation is kind of contingent on, well, can they offer all of this and there are other moves that have to be made, you absolutely have some insider trading here if you are the Warriors and you should.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: The 50-50 odds of LeBron James joining the Golden State Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I'd say it's about 50-50 right now, and Mark, I think it's Golden State and Cleveland.
quotes.quote: I'd say it's about 50-50 right now, and Mark, I think it's Golden State and Cleveland. I just don't see another team that makes that much sense because on a strictly basketball standpoint, it's San Antonio. You plug LeBron in there, he fills a whole bunch of needs for that group on top of being the veteran that you would have next to Wemby who goes, hey, I've been here before, let me show you the ways a little bit.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: The Warriors' culture and its ability to handle LeBron James's star power
quotes.excerpt: The Warriors have a culture that can handle the star power that is LeBron James.
quotes.quote: The Warriors on top of all that, and I think this has kind of gotten lost in the shuffle, they let their players kind of be who they are. I mean, look at Jimmy Butler, guys. He had all these blow-ups in all these different places, and he's comfortable out here. The Warriors have a culture that can handle the star power that is LeBron James. He knows it, he saw it with Kevin Durant, he's seen it through time with Steph. Steph sets the tone for everybody else to follow.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's priority is basketball happiness over money
quotes.excerpt: It's not about money, the legacy is secure, it's where he would feel most comfortable.
quotes.quote: I take what has come out from the people closest to LeBron at face value, Mr. Grani, and that is it's not about money, the legacy is secure, it's where he would feel most comfortable. And I can promise you guys, having done this for a long, long time in a lot of different places, nothing spells basketball happiness like playing with Steph Curry.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: Potential roster moves if LeBron James joins the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: The short answer right now, Mark, is Moses Moody, would they have to trade him out
quotes.quote: The short answer right now, Mark, is Moses Moody, would they have to trade him out to clear out some more space? We'll see. I'm not sure how all of that works. What I am most fascinated by though, and it's another part that I feel like hasn't gotten nearly as much attention in the last couple days as people come to grips with the fact that this actually might happen and he might come here, is what happens then with Jimmy?

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: The potential impact of LeBron James, Steph Curry, and Draymond Green playing together
quotes.excerpt: I am really interested to see if this does play out, how Jimmy and LeBron would be
quotes.quote: I am really interested to see if this does play out, how Jimmy and LeBron would be out there on the floor together with Draymond. You have a hell of a lot of length and you have guys that have played at a very high level defensively for a long time, but those guys are not shooting threes. That is a strange looking lineup out there offensively and there's going to be a hell of a lot of pressure on Steph, but we'll cross that bridge when we get to it.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of Steve Kerr's role in managing LeBron James's ego
quotes.excerpt: I think Steve Kerr is important in this equation because he knows what he's getting every day.
quotes.quote: I think his relationship with Draymond is important, I think his relationship with Steph and the way the ice has thawed through the last few years between those two and the success they had together on Team USA, I think that's important. And absolutely, I think Steve Kerr is important in this equation because he knows what he's getting every day and Kerr is widely regarded as not only one of the best coaches of all time, but a guy who knows how to handle egos. You can't get a much bigger ego than LeBron and the Warriors can deal with it.

quotes.speaker: Nick Friedell
quotes.summary_phrase: The Warriors' current roster limitations regarding winning titles
quotes.excerpt: This team isn't built to win titles anymore. You bring LeBron in, certainly you've got attention
quotes.quote: This team isn't built to win titles anymore. You bring LeBron in, certainly you've got attention and fans can dream, but that's not the goal as you start the season on a team that is so veteran-heavy that we're still talking about, well, who's going to play night to night leading into next season. You hope that at the end of the year, you can be healthy and give yourselves a puncher's chance.
